section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section summarizes findings from a study examining interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation and its connection to intuitive eating among college women. Body appreciation served as a central mediator between caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, perfectionism, and intuitive eating, suggesting it is an important clinical intervention target. The study found that body appreciation did not predict depressive symptoms, indicating it is distinct from negative body image.
